name: Text & Markdown to PDF
Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)

seo.metaTitle: Text & Markdown to PDF — free, in your browser | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Paste text or Markdown and get a paginated A4 PDF built locally in your browser. No upload, no account. Does not read.docx files.
seo.aeoSummary: Word to PDF converter processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.question: Does Word to PDF converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Word to PDF converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory. No data leaves your device.
faqs.q: Does Word to PDF converter upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Word to PDF converter executes 100% inside your browser's local memory. No data leaves your device.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Word to PDF converter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/word_to_pdf.json or open /tools/word-to-pdf?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

steps: Paste or load your text data directly into the input editor.
Apply transformations, formatting, or validation rules in real time.
Copy the output or save the result with zero data transmitted over the network.

task: Turn pasted text into a PDF
desc: Typeset pasted text or Markdown into a paginated A4/Letter PDF inside the tab. Headings become bold section titles and long documents break across pages. It does not open.docx files — a Word file has to be copied in as text first.
